name: Nan o Nan
description: Warm Persian bakery & coffee roastery — saffron palette, serif headings. Pairs with the 'Nan o Nan' coded menu design.
welcomeMessage: Artisan bakery & coffee roastery — baked fresh, brewed with care since 1972.
